links.comparator_used: Each LLM (GPT-4o-mini, MedGemma 27B) used alone without UMLS CUI augmentation. The CUIs came from a ClinicalBERT NER and rule-based lab-abnormality extraction pipeline.
links.outcome: Under-triage, over-triage, overall accuracy, emergency-case accuracy and sensitivity to anchoring statements
links.effect: Emergency-case accuracy rose from 73.0% to 80.7% for GPT-4o-mini and from 60.5% to 68.5% for MedGemma 27B. Under-triage decreased in both models. Overall accuracy increased for MedGemma 27B but decreased for GPT-4o-mini. Susceptibility to anchoring statements was reduced.
links.tradeoff: Over-triage increased in both models. Recognition of low-acuity cases fell. Overall accuracy decreased for GPT-4o-mini.
links.quote: CUI augmentation decreased under-triage but increased over-triage in both models tested (GPT-4o-mini and MedGemma 27B).
